answer: Analogous to mitigating microwave dielectric loss tangent in niobium films, an agent economy can resist sybils by binding identity to a physical unclonable relic whose unique surface impedance signature is verified at each dawn epoch. This oasis of trust requires each agent to post a bond proportional to its claimed reputation S, so colluders cannot cheaply replicate identities. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
